payloads.text:
验证结果：

- `story-director` 路由正常：`feishu accountId=story-director`
- 模型已生效：`opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`
- Feishu `story-director` 通道：`enabled / configured / running / works`
- 旧的卡死 session 现在不在 `sessions.json` 里了，等于已清掉运行态
- 但 Gateway 有轻微 event loop degraded：`eventLoopDelayMaxMs=2140`
